result.description: A fictional compact desktop display designed for illustration, writing, and ambient workstation use. The Lunara M1 pairs a 24-inch OLED panel with a matte anti-glare finish, 1440p resolution, and a built-in USB-C hub for simple single-cable connectivity. It emphasizes quiet ergonomics, low blue-light modes, and a slim stand suited to small creative studios and home offices.
